Metadata.title: SYSTEMA.WORKS — websites, apps, automation and AI
Metadata.description: We build websites, web and mobile apps, automation and AI solutions. One team for the whole cycle: from idea to launch and support.

Landing.heroTitle: Websites, apps and AI automation for business
Landing.heroSubtitle: We take a project from idea to launch and support it afterwards: design, development, integrations, AI. One team, clear stages and deadlines.
Landing.fact1Label: Localization built in from the first version
Landing.fact2Label: Design, development and launch without middlemen
Landing.fact3Label: We reply to every inquiry within a day
Landing.servicesIntro: The whole cycle in one team: discovery, design, development, integrations, launch and growth.
Landing.service1Body: Fast pages with a clear offer, SEO-ready structure and conversion analytics.
Landing.service2Body: Client portals, dashboards, marketplaces and internal systems that grow with your business.
Landing.service3Body: iOS and Android: native and cross-platform apps connected to your backend and CRM.
Landing.service4Body: We bring neural networks into business processes: AI assistants and bots, document and inquiry handling, CRM and messenger integrations, SMM automation.
Landing.caseTitle: monte.guide — a service directory for Montenegro
Landing.caseBody: A live product we build and maintain: service search, a Telegram bot with a Mini App, a business cabinet, profiles and favorites. Four languages and installable as a PWA.
Landing.processIntro: Short iterations and checkpoints against the schedule.
Landing.step1Body: We define goals, audience and metrics. You get a clear scope and priorities.
Landing.step2Body: We map the user journey, structure and integrations. You get an approved plan.
Landing.step3Body: Short iterations with testing and analytics included. You get a release.
Landing.step4Body: We improve conversion, automate routine work and add what the business needs next.
Landing.contactBody: Message us in the messenger you prefer: a few lines about the goal, timing and how to reach you. We'll reply with a plan and next steps.
Landing.contactNote: We reply within 24 hours · English, Srpski, Русский, Українська

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and how we store it.

dataCollection.title: 1. Data Collection
dataCollection.content: We collect the following types of data:
items: Contact details (name, email, phone, messenger account) that you send us yourself
Project information (goals, timeline, budget) needed for project estimation
Technical data (IP address, browser, device) for security purposes
The content of your correspondence with us in messengers and by email

dataUsage.title: 2. Data Usage
items: Replying to your inquiry and making an initial project estimate
Contacting you to discuss project details
Improving the quality of our services

dataStorage.title: 3. Data Storage
dataStorage.content: We keep correspondence for as long as it is needed to answer your inquiry and work on the project, and no longer. You can ask us to delete your data at any time.

dataSharing.title: 4. Data Sharing
dataSharing.content: We do not share your data with third parties, except:
items: Sharing with company staff in order to contact you
Your explicit requests to share data

security.title: 5. Security
security.content: We use modern data protection methods including encryption, access control, and regular security audits.

yourRights.title: 6. Your Rights
items: Request a copy of your data

cookies.title: 7. Cookies
cookies.content: The website does not use advertising or analytics cookies. We only store a cookie with your chosen interface language, which you can disable in your browser settings.

contact.title: 8. Contact
contact.content: For data processing inquiries, contact: privacy@systema.works

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.intro: By using our website and services, you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully before using our services.

services.title: 1. Services
services.content: SYSTEMA.WORKS provides services for website development, web applications, mobile applications, business process automation and AI solutions implementation.

consultation.title: 2. Consultation
consultation.content: The initial consultation is informational. We send the final estimate and proposal in writing.

userObligations.title: 3. User Obligations
userObligations.content: When using our services, you agree to:
items: Provide accurate and complete project information
Not use the service for illegal purposes
Not disrupt the service or attempt unauthorized access
Maintain a respectful tone in communication

intellectualProperty.title: 4. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: All website materials, including texts, design, logos, and code, are the property of SYSTEMA.WORKS and protected by copyright law.

limitationOfLiability.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
limitationOfLiability.content: We are not liable for indirect damages, lost profits, or data loss resulting from the use of our services.

modifications.title: 6. Terms Modifications
modifications.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes take effect upon publication on the website.

governingLaw.title: 7. Governing Law
governingLaw.content: These terms are governed by the laws of Montenegro. All disputes are resolved in the court at the company's registered location.

contact.title: 8. Contact
contact.content: For terms of service inquiries, contact: legal@systema.works
